component.name: YT Grabber
component.summary: Download YouTube and YouTube Music videos and playlists

description.p: YT Grabber downloads videos, playlists (even with thousands of items), albums and channels from YouTube and YouTube Music from a local web page.

ul.li: Exactly 10 simultaneous downloads, even with several playlists in the queue
Every failed video is listed with its number and the exact reason, with a one-click retry
Playlists and channels can be kept up to date automatically

description.p: Only download content you have the right to save.
